description: This file defines an interface named DDataWriter used for managing distributed subscriber-topic relationships within an Akka cluster, specifically for performing operations like adding and removing subscribers or addresses with specified write consistency.

classes.name: DDataWriter
classes.description: A generic interface for writing and managing distributed subscriber-topic data in an Akka cluster environment.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Associates a subscriber with a topic, returning a future that completes upon success or failure.

methods.name: removeSubscriber
methods.description: Removes a specific subscriber from the distributed data, with the operation's success or failure reflected in the returned future.

methods.name: removeAddress
methods.description: Removes all subscribers associated with a specific cluster address, with completion status indicated by the returned future.
